decision.rationale: All thirteen attacks the prompt names are refuted, and five further attacks of this reviewer's own were run and also refuted. The claim the entry rests on — independent dual ACCEPT 0/0 of v3 — was verified by opening both Stage A files rather than trusting the table: both are ACCEPT with zero blockers, zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX, and both reviewed subject digest 31d37bb0…, the frozen v3. The lineage claim over D-170 through D-190 was verified across all twenty-one decisions, as was the 'after D-190' increment.
